operating_days: Monday to Friday (Closed: Saturdays, Sundays, Public Holidays, and Year-end/New Year holidays Dec 29 – Jan 3)

eligible_groups: Elementary and Junior High school students
Preschoolers (Free if accompanied by an adult; 100 yen otherwise)

passes.note: Commuter and student passes are available (refer to website for 1-month and 3-month rates).

reservation_methods.note: Reservations accepted from 1 week prior until 30 minutes before boarding.

reservation_window: From 1 week in advance until 30 minutes before the scheduled ride
important_notes: Prior user registration at the village office is mandatory.
Ride-sharing is required; arrival times are not guaranteed.
Service is restricted to travel within Showa Village and designated points in Numata City.
